verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server, so an AI agent could plausibly drive Stripe with natural-language commands. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) also support agent use. Nothing in the evidence shows the MCP server covers Treasury financial-account operations, or that Treasury has its own natural-language interface. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers Treasury actions (financial accounts, outbound payments, transactions), a native natural-language command interface in the Dashboard, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
